items.title: Can ant foraging survive without a central brain?
items.hook: What happens when coordination is pushed to the edges and no single component has the full picture?
items.experiment: Give each agent a small rule set and local information. Let the group coordinate movement, then compare centralized and decentralized outcomes under identical disturbances.
items.question: How little communication does a useful swarm need?
items.caveat: A simulation prompt, not evidence that a real deployment would work.
